title: 管道原位固化內襯
summary: 本課聚焦連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剩餘厚度判讀」與「理想薄環屈曲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Remaining thickness interpretation" and "Ideal thin ring buckling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘厚度判讀」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining thickness interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘厚度判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support. An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining thickness interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘厚度判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining thickness interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剩餘厚度判讀
knowledge.text: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。
knowledge.textEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「管道原位固化內襯」的「剩餘厚度判讀：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Remaining thickness interpretation: mechanism and system paths” in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「剩餘厚度判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Remaining thickness interpretation" is correct?
options: 只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。
只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count.
A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘厚度判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining thickness interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剩餘厚度判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Remaining thickness interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 只要厚度立方敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
optionsEn: A nominal result for cubic thickness sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘厚度判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining thickness interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。同時排除以下干擾原因：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。同時排除以下干擾原因：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
knowledge.textEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剩餘厚度判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Remaining thickness interpretation"?
options: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘厚度判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining thickness interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剩餘厚度判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Remaining thickness interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness.
A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 理想薄環屈曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal thin ring buckling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想薄環屈曲」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal thin ring buckling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。此模型是均勻圓環且無側向拘束的理想彈性上限尺度，實際設計須另考慮長期模數、橢圓及土體互制。假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想薄環屈曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The thin-ring model illustrates cubic sensitivity to thickness ratio for an ideal uniform circular elastic ring without lateral restraint; real design additionally requires long-term modulus, ovality and soil interaction. For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal thin ring buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想薄環屈曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal thin ring buckling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理想薄環屈曲
knowledge.text: 外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。此模型是均勻圓環且無側向拘束的理想彈性上限尺度，實際設計須另考慮長期模數、橢圓及土體互制。
knowledge.textEn: External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The thin-ring model illustrates cubic sensitivity to thickness ratio for an ideal uniform circular elastic ring without lateral restraint; real design additionally requires long-term modulus, ovality and soil interaction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理想薄環屈曲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ideal thin ring buckling" is correct?
options: 只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。
optionsEn: A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
External water pressure can buckle a liner inward.
quiz.explanation: 外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理想薄環屈曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal thin ring buckling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想薄環屈曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal thin ring buckling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理想薄環屈曲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ideal thin ring buckling", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa。
只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa.
A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理想薄環屈曲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal thin ring buckling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想薄環屈曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal thin ring buckling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接理想薄環屈曲時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over ideal thin ring buckling, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接理想薄環屈曲時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over ideal thin ring buckling, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想薄環屈曲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ideal thin ring buckling"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。
只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method.
A nominal result for bypass storage demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理想薄環屈曲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ideal thin ring buckling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想薄環屈曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ideal thin ring buckling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「理想薄環屈曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ideal thin ring buckling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results.
quiz.explanation: 初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
